description: Printable parametric box with wall thickness, fillets, and lid clearance
description_en: Printable parametric box with wall thickness, fillets, and lid clearance
manufacturing_notes: Keep wall thickness at least 1.2 mm for FDM
Leave 0.25 mm lid clearance per side
failure_modes: Shell fails when wall thickness exceeds half the smallest dimension
Fillet fails when radius is too large for wall thickness
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# [Body]
# [Dimension]
width_mm = 90  # [40:1:180]
# [Dimension]
depth_mm = 60  # [30:1:140]
# [Dimension]
height_mm = 32  # [15:1:90]
# [Dimension]
wall_thickness_mm = 2  # [1.2:0.2:5]
# [Dimension]
fillet_radius_mm = 2  # [0.5:0.5:5]

outer = cq.Workplane("XY").box(width_mm, depth_mm, height_mm)
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=wall_thickness_mm)
    .box(width_mm - 2 * wall_thickness_mm, depth_mm - 2 * wall_thickness_mm, height_mm)
)
result = outer.cut(inner).edges("|Z").fillet(fillet_radius_mm)
show_object(result)
